title: tome-book/1
description: book.yaml: one book in the workspace. The source PDF stays where it is, so only its path and hash are kept. A config file MUST NOT hold a secret.

budget_usd.description: The hard limit for this book, in US dollars.

chapters.description: Which chapters to translate: 3, 1-3 or 1,3,5, counted from 1.

chapter_level.description: Which level of nested bookmarks makes a chapter. Level N takes every bookmark down to depth N, in reading order. 1 when left out.

pii_exceptions.description: Strings the personal data gate must let through, such as an NPC with the same name.

patterns.description: Extra masking patterns for this book alone, written as in a rule pack's syntax_patterns.yaml. A pattern with the id of a pack pattern replaces it; every book pattern goes before the pack's, so it wins a tie.

use.description: A book takes masking patterns only.

flags.description: Added to the g and u flags, which are always on.
